title: Stop a root CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md from silently suppressing methodologies
description: A repo-root CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md is auto-discovered (agents_management.rs ~175-199 and the Python mirror) and replaces the embedded template; a pre-methodologies copy drops every methodology section while setup agents exits 0. Undefined template variables (e.g. a stale {% for line in gherkin_example %}) render as empty blocks without warning. Per the no-fallback policy, prefer one explicit setting (project_management_template) over auto-discovery; if auto-discovery stays, document it in docs/CONFIGURATION.md. Either way: fail (or at minimum warn) when methodologies are configured but the template lacks the methodologies loop; use strict undefined variables so a missing variable is an error; add the same template-loop check to kbs doctor. Kanbus's own repo has this root template too (see the AGENTS size sub-task under kbs-76b265f8).
